Never expose encryption keys, OTPs, sessions, raw answers, addresses, database credentials, payment secrets or provider secrets.
Do not rotate QUIZ_ENCRYPTION_KEY_V2 or IDENTITY_HMAC_KEY without an explicit continuity plan.
Do not mutate frozen release candidate branches.
Do not change the current Hostinger hPanel branch selection; prior branch changes reset environment variables.
Keep Printful production confirmation disabled until the explicit manufacturing launch gate.
Do not create real Safepay charges solely for QA.
Do not apply referral migrations 0029, 0034 or 0035 to production without explicit production referral-activation approval.

Do not send creator launch outreach until referral migrations are live, the intended creator roster is reviewed, provider email configuration is green and the Owner explicitly triggers /ops/referral-launch.
Do not cut issuedonce.shop until all temporary-host provider, customer-flow and email-deliverability gates are green.
